definitions.explanation: Something that causes trouble or concern.

examples.japanese: {頭痛|ずつう}{薬|やく}を{飲|の}んだ。
この{問題|もんだい}は{頭痛|ずつう}の{種|たね}だ。
examples.english: This problem is a source of headaches.

notes:
{頭痛|ずつう} refers to headaches, both literal and figurative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頭痛|ずつう}がする (to have a headache)
- {頭痛|ずつう}がひどい (to have a terrible headache)
- {頭痛|ずつう}{薬|やく} (headache medicine)
- {頭痛|ずつう}の{種|たね} (source of headaches, cause for worry)
- {偏|へん}{頭痛|ずつう} (migraine)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {頭|あたま}が{痛|いた}い: my head hurts (describes the sensation)
- {頭痛|ずつう}がする: to have a headache (describes the condition)

OTHER BODY PAIN VOCABULARY:
- {腹痛|ふくつう} (stomachache)
- {歯痛|しつう} (toothache)
- {腰痛|ようつう} (back pain)
